title: Regulatory Impact Simulation
rationale: When a new regulation appears, CISOs need to know: What controls are affected? What policies need updates? What risks increase? This is an advanced AI feature that requires the Obligation Management (PRD-009) and Control Testing (PRD-008) modules to be built first.

user_stories.story: As a Compliance Officer, when a regulation is updated, I want the system to compare the old and new versions and highlight what changed, so that I understand the impact immediately.
acceptance_criteria: System shows a diff between regulation versions.
Changed sections are highlighted with AI-generated summary of changes.

user_stories.story: As a Compliance Officer, I want the system to predict which of my existing controls, policies, and obligations are impacted by a new regulation, so that I can plan remediation.
acceptance_criteria: AI scans new regulation text against existing control/policy descriptions.
Returns a scored list of impacted items (High/Medium/Low impact).
Creates draft Findings (PRD-007) for high-impact items.

user_stories.story: As a CISO, I want an estimated remediation effort (hours/cost) for adopting a new regulation, so that I can budget appropriately.
acceptance_criteria: System estimates effort based on number of impacted controls and historical remediation velocity.
Estimate is displayed alongside the impact report.
